page.title: About Smoked sea salt tin, 4 oz

product.name: Smoked sea salt tin, 4 oz
product.description: You will find alder-smoked salt and not much else, packed a market morning as batch linen tray thirty four.

blocks.text: Bring it out for a roast vegetable, packed in a tin with a slip lid from Two Harbors, batch maple hook seventy three.
A toasty note is the note on batch cork loft sixteen, and keep the lid on so the smoke stays in the tin.
The crew at the back bakery uses a cool rest for this, and this one is batch brass nook forty seven.
A baker on the early shift likes it for a roast vegetable and wrote batch copper bin sixty on the slip.

presentation.review_line: Look over the figures before you pay.

modal.name: Maple spoon
modal.text: You can take Maple spoon as well, at five dollars and ninety cents.
